highlights.reason_zh: Cursor 官方确认恶意扩展曾触达最多 5,000 名用户；受影响主机必须按 IoC 修复并轮换凭据。
highlights.reason_en: Cursor confirms a malicious extension reached at most 5,000 users; affected hosts need indicator-based remediation and credential rotation.

highlights.reason_zh: NemoClaw 给出可自持 agent 栈的公开组合路径；隔离与成本仍需独立实测。
highlights.reason_en: NemoClaw provides a public composition path for owned agent stacks; isolation and cost still need independent tests.

highlights.reason_zh: 目录写入与恢复策略修复直接影响长任务的权限边界，适合回归后升级。
highlights.reason_en: Directory-write and resume-policy fixes directly affect long-task permission boundaries and support adoption after regression tests.

highlights.reason_zh: Clover 的公开权重让扩散 coding 模型可验证，但厂商 benchmark 尚未复现。
highlights.reason_en: Clover’s public weights make a diffusion coding model testable, while publisher benchmarks remain unreproduced.

highlights.reason_zh: Lumma 把决策模型权重与代码开放；校准和小型翻译集决定它只能先做有限试验。
highlights.reason_en: Lumma opens decision-model weights and code; calibration and the small translated set limit it to a bounded trial.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并完成阅读，并补查官方博客、GitHub、Hugging Face、arXiv、小团队、非英语材料和重大综合新闻。NemoClaw 距截止 116 秒；GPT-6 Luna 只有日期精度而暂缓。厂商 benchmark 尚未独立复现。 召回自检补录 Cursor 安全事故、Anthropic 临床前案例、Pika 权重，并将 tinyworldformer 以 IGNORE 入库。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were fully read, supplemented by official blogs, GitHub, Hugging Face, arXiv, small teams, non-English materials and exceptional general-news review. NemoClaw landed 116 seconds before cutoff; a date-only GPT-6 Luna update was deferred. Vendor benchmarks remain independently unreproduced. Recall audit added the Cursor security incident, Anthropic preclinical cases and Pika weights, and recorded tinyworldformer as IGNORE.
